answer: The cheapest real defence: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because walnut only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, ledge is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any quartz approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
